description: List the tenant's catalog discounts: name, type (general = everyone, coupon = needs its couponCode, business = a customer discount group), percent off, validity window (validFrom through validUntil, both tenant-local days included) and whether it is active today, and the item, brand and category ids it is limited to (empty = no limit). Also returns the customer discount groups business discounts target. Filter by type, activeOnly or a case-insensitive name/coupon search; paged (default 100, max 500). Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.

activeOnly.description: true = only discounts whose validity window includes today.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of the name or coupon code.

type.description: Optional type filter: general, coupon or business.

name: list_discounts
title: List Discounts
